paragraphs.text: okay so this one is all over the place. i made this album right after i moved to wisconsin for college- it was right in the thick of the pandemic and i literally didn't know and couldn't meet anyone. maybe the most miserable year of my adult life, but also the most exciting? i think i just wandered around menomonie sketching game ideas and noodling out songs until this album came together.

there are some genuinely great songs on this album, but also a couple of incoherent messes. chalk this one up to experimentation- i had just learned how to sidechain but definitely hadn't figured out mastering yet. it's pretty silly, for sure more of a learning album than anything.
